categories.main_business_segments: Science Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. specializes in heavy metal pollution prevention and control, offering comprehensive solutions including treatment of heavy metal-containing acidic wastewater, wastewater, and waste residue, environmental remediation, production and sales of reagents and equipment, design and technical services, environmental management, consulting, and testing. The company operates through three main business segments: comprehensive heavy metal pollution prevention solutions, product sales (reagents and integrated wastewater treatment equipment), and operation services (third-party entrusted operation of pollution control facilities).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include heavy metal acidic wastewater resource recovery, deep treatment and reuse of heavy metal wastewater, arsenic-containing hazardous waste detoxification and mineralization, and heavy metal contaminated soil remediation. It employs advanced biological reagents based on composite coordination compounds, integrated modular wastewater treatment equipment, and proprietary chemical reagents such as bioagents, polymer adsorbents, stabilizers, oxidants, and mineralizers. Production methods include customized manufacturing of core and auxiliary equipment, reagent production, and integrated engineering services with a focus on standardization and intelligent control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily large-scale non-ferrous metal mining, beneficiation, and smelting enterprises, industrial parks, and government entities responsible for environmental management. The company serves the heavy metal pollution control market in the non-ferrous metals industry and related sectors, including copper, lead, zinc, and arsenic waste treatment. It also targets international markets through subsidiaries in Serbia and Australia, expanding its global footprint.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operations are based in China, with headquarters and production facilities in Changsha, Hunan Province. It has subsidiaries and operational projects domestically and internationally, including in Serbia and Australia. Domestic revenue dominates, but overseas business has shown rapid growth, especially in Serbia, Australia, Mongolia, and the Democratic Republic of Congo.
categories.supply_chain_position: Science Environmental Protection operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the heavy metal pollution control supply chain. It provides integrated environmental solutions, including technology development, equipment manufacturing, engineering construction, and operation and maintenance services. The company also procures specialized equipment and reagents from suppliers but focuses on core technology and system integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in heavy metal pollution prevention technologies, focusing on resource recovery, zero discharge, and cost-effective solutions. R&D priorities include advancing acidic wastewater resource recovery, arsenic detoxification, deep wastewater treatment, soil remediation, and intelligent control systems. It invests heavily in R&D, maintains collaborations with universities and research institutes, and pursues patent development and technology industrialization to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through three main channels: (1) comprehensive heavy metal pollution prevention solution projects delivered via EPC or partial service contracts; (2) sales of proprietary reagents and integrated wastewater treatment equipment; and (3) third-party entrusted operation services under BOT, BOO, and O&M models, charging fees for ongoing environmental facility management and optimization.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading high-tech enterprise in the heavy metal pollution prevention sector in China, recognized for its advanced core technologies and comprehensive service capabilities. It competes with other specialized environmental protection firms, particularly in the non-ferrous metals pollution control niche. The industry is fragmented with low concentration, but Science Environmental Protection’s technological edge, integrated solutions, and expanding international presence place it in the first tier of competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 808 million, a 47.47% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 90.3 million, up 36.39%. Total assets reached RMB 1.49 billion, with net assets of RMB 931.8 million. The company has shown strong growth driven by increased solution projects, product sales, and operational services, supported by enhanced brand recognition and marketing reforms.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers stable, cost-effective, and resource-efficient heavy metal pollution control solutions with high integration and simplicity. Its proprietary biological reagents enable simultaneous deep removal of multiple heavy metals and organic pollutants with low sludge production and operational costs. The integrated modular equipment is highly adaptable and intelligent, facilitating rapid deployment and effective treatment. The company’s comprehensive service model, combining technology, products, and operation, ensures long-term environmental risk control and cost reduction for clients.
